chapter.verse: Khat leh khat thu na neih uh ciangin misiangthote khensak loin Lawkite a khensak ngam ding note lakah khat beek na om uh hiam?
Misiangthote in leitung mite thu a khen ding uh thei lo na hi uh hiam? Note in leitung mite thukhen takpi ding na hih uh leh, thuneute a khen dingin kilawm lo na hi uh hiam?
Eite in vantungmite thu i khen ding thei lo na hi uh hiam? Tua ahih ciangin leitung thu a khen dingin kilawm zaw hilo na hi uh hiam?
Tua ahih ciangin leitung thu na khen ding uh leh, pawlpi sungah mi ginalote thukhen ding za-ah bang hangin na koih uh hiam?
Tua bang ka cih inah, note zum nadingin kong ci hi. A ute a naute thu khensak thei ding note lakah lungpil nei mi khat beek om lo ahi hiam?
U tawh nau tawh kisel tham loin, thu-um lote mai-ah na kikhia tazen uh hi!

Tua bangin note in khat leh khat na kitot uh ciangin na guallelhna uh a kilang mahmah hi. Thuum loin bawlsiatna bang hangin thuak zaw lo na hi uh hiam? Bang hangin sum zatna thuak zaw lo na hi uh hiam?
Tua bang thuak lo tham loin, ahi lopi kibawlna na kihih tazen uh a, u leh nau, khat leh khat in sum na kilaksak uh hi.

Mi diklote in Pasian’ Gam a luah theih loh ding thu thei lo na hi uh hiam? Na kikheem kei un: Numei tawh a mawhte, milim a biate, mi’ zi tawh a mawhte, pasal leh pasal a khialte, tua thute ah thuneite;
sum gutate, huaiham duhhopte, zukham theite, hangsan kosiate, zawhthawh bawla sum sutte in Pasian’ Gam a luah kei ding uh hi.
Note kimkhat in nidang lai-inah tuate bangin na om uh zongin, tu-in Topa Zeisu Khazih’ min leh i Pasian’ Kha Siangtho tawh na kisilsiang uh a, siangthona leh dikkisakna na ngah uh hi.
Keimah in na khempeuh ka bawl theih hangin na khempeuh hih ding a kilawm kei hi. Na khempeuh ka hih theih hangin tuate khat’ sila-in ka kai kei ding hi.

An leh tui in gilpi ading, gilpi in zong an leh tui ading ahih hangin tua tegel Pasian in a siasak ding hi. Pumpi in numei tawh khialhna ading ahi kei hi: Topa ading hi a, Topa in zong pumpi ading ahi hi.
Pasian in ama vangliatna tawh Zeisu thosak a, eite zong hong thosak ding hi.
Note pumpi un Khazih’ pumpi’ nate ahi uh hi cih thei lo na hi uh hiam? Tua ahih ciangin Khazih’ pumpi’ nate la-in numei gilo’ nate ka piangsak ding hiam? Tua bang hi lo ding hi.
Numei gilo tawh kipawlte in numei gilo tawh pumkhat sakhat ahi uh hi cih thei lo na hi uh hiam? Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, “Tua tegel in pumkhat sakhat ahi ding hi,” kici hi.
Topa tawh kipawlte in Topa tawh lungsim khat ahi ding hi.
Numei tawh mawhna pan taikhia un. Mi in ahih theih khialhna a vekpi-in pumpi pua lamah om hi. Numei tawh a khial mi in ahih leh, ama pum tungah a khial hi.
Note pumpi in Pasian hong piak, na sung uhah a teeng Kha Siangtho’ biakna inn ahi zong, na pumpi uh no’ aa ahi lo ahi zongin thei lo na hi uh hiam?
Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, man tawh a kilei zo na hi uh hi. Tua ahih ciangin na pumpi sung uhah Pasian na phat un.
